description: This file defines the NotesController class, a REST API controller managing CRUD operations for notes in a backend application. It handles HTTP requests such as retrieving all notes, getting a note by ID, creating, updating, and deleting notes.

classes.name: NotesController
classes.description: An API controller class for managing notes, exposing endpoints for CRUD operations.

methods.name: GetAll
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve all notes.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve a specific note by its GUID ID.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles HTTP POST requests to create a new note with provided details.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Handles HTTP PUT requests to update an existing note identified by its GUID ID.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Handles HTTP DELETE requests to remove a note by its GUID ID.
